rationale: Under the fixed, deterministic replay and frozen F oracle, removing b directly tests whether {a,c} remains sufficient. Persistence licenses dropping b; disappearance makes b necessary in that configuration. These bounded conclusions do not require identifying a globally smallest subset or a unique root cause.

signal_basis.exact_text: Partition changes, replay subsets and complements, and evaluate single-removal tests using the recorded result and the specified target failure definition.
Replays are deterministic under the fixed workload and environment.
The current tests leave {a,b,c} and {a,c} unresolved as the required reproducing subset.
The target failure F is the checkout deadline failure during a fixed replay.
